implementation: ActorBehaviour chooses player or automatic decisions, ticks one MovementBehaviour once, then runs player equipment post-processing.
MoveTo/path navigation submit frame-local intentions instead of integrating coordinates; platform, terrain and cabin are function backends of the same movement executor.
CanJump gates input buffering/start in all movement backends; disabled jumping still falls and lands.
EnableAirControl gates input correction only; inertia, release drag, gravity, collision and input-facing continue.
One MovementConfig IConfigData per definition; MovementDefinition is its immutable calculation snapshot, not a second authored config or state owner.
ActorState remains the only state owner; no new network simulation or framework source modifications.

compatibility.note: Full unified MovementConfig fingerprint replaces the old air-only fingerprint. Prior content can fail strict handshake/save content checks; old files are preserved without automatic migration.
